summary: Waddle into mystery with down-on-his-luck detective Eugene McQuacklin!
description:
Note: Play the first two levels for FREE! (About 10 mins of gameplay) Unlock to play the full game.

SOLVING CRIMES IS NO WALK IN THE POND
Welcome to Duck Detective, a cozy, story-driven adventure game! Dive into this funny, comedy-filled puzzle adventure, where you play as Eugene McQuacklin, a down-on-his-luck Duck Detective, on a mission to crack the case. Use your sharp de-duck-tive reasoning to find hidden clues, solve puzzles, and expose the truth behind a sinister salami conspiracy.

FEATURES:
- A 2-3 Hour Cozy Mystery Adventure: Ideal for players who love story-driven detective games with a comedic twist.
- Interview Suspects & Solve Puzzles: Inspect and interview suspects to learn their hidden secrets, then use the information you’ve gathered (plus your own de-duck-tive reasoning) to locate the suspect and bust the case wide open!
- Fully Voice-Acted, Hilarious Adventure: Enjoy a story-rich game filled with funny characters and witty dialogue.
- Crack Down on Crime: Throw bread to the fine beak of lady justice!
- Solve Mysteries With Just a Stare: Judge everyone on first impressions, just by looking at them really, really hard! Get them to admit things by staring! Do ducks blink? You don’t.
- Localization: English only

JOIN THE QUIRKIEST ADVENTURE
Do you have what it takes to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and interrogate suspects? As the Duck Detective, explore a world brimming with comedy and mystery. Use your detective skills to interview characters, inspect evidence, and connect the dots. This cozy adventure blends the best of point-and-click games with a story-rich, funny experience that keeps you entertained till the last quack!

BUST THE CASE WIDE OPEN
In Duck Detective, it’s up to you to explore crime scenes, solve funny puzzles, and reveal the culprit using nothing but your wits (and perhaps a bit of bread). Every detail matters as you gather evidence, laugh through comedic twists, and solve clever puzzles. This quirky detective adventure is perfect for fans of short, funny games packed with humor and mystery!

WHY PLAY DUCK DETECTIVE?
If you’re a fan of cozy adventure games with a comedic twist, like Frog Detective or Later Alligator, or if you enjoyed the mystery-solving of Return of the Obra Dinn, this game is your next favorite! Packed with funny puzzles, hidden clues, and plenty of laughs, Duck Detective is the perfect choice for fans of story-driven adventures.

DOWNLOAD NOW!
Ready to crack cases, solve puzzles, and enjoy a good laugh? Duck Detective is waiting for you! Download now and dive into this funny, comedy-filled adventure!
